Debug.Title: Debugging workbench
Debug.Lead: Diagnose problems systematically: repair deliberately broken macros, decode error messages, inspect live objects without changing them, and watch hooks fire.
Debug.BrokenLead: Each macro has a described symptom, an expected behaviour and a test case. The root cause is revealed only through hints and the solution.
Debug.ExplainerLead: Paste an error message from the console. The explainer only describes what the message itself says; it never invents details.
Debug.InspectorLead: Read-only view of a live document. Nothing is modified and no methods are called.
Debug.NothingToInspect: Nothing to inspect: select a token, join a combat or choose another target.
Debug.HooksLead: Watch Foundry hooks as they fire. Monitoring starts only when you press Start and stops when you press Stop or close the academy.
Debug.NoHooksSelected: Select at least one hook to watch.

Diagnostics.Title: Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Lead: Environment facts, compatibility warnings, the practice fixtures, and a copyable report for bug reports. The report contains no passwords, tokens or campaign data.
Diagnostics.Workflows: Supported system workflows the curriculum teaches
Diagnostics.ReportLead: Copy this into a bug report or support request.

Help.Title: Help
Help.Step1: Open the Curriculum and start with Tier 0. Each lesson explains an idea in plain English, shows a working example, a broken version and the fix, then gives you exercises.
Help.Step2: Do the exercises. Concept checks run inside the lesson; code exercises open in the Workshop, where automated checks tell you exactly what passed.
Help.Step3: Take the knowledge checkpoint and the practical challenge. A lesson is complete when its required exercises and checkpoint pass; it is mastered when the challenge passes without revealing a solution.
Help.Step4: Use hints freely. Revealing the final solution step records the exercise as solution-assisted; you can always retry later for an independent pass.
Help.Step5: Build your own macros in the Workshop: save drafts, compare with starter code, export to a file or create a real Macro document when you are ready.
Help.Safety1: The Concept Sandbox runs your code in a Web Worker with no access to the page or to Foundry. The Foundry Preview runs in the same worker against an emulated Foundry built from a read-only snapshot: changes are recorded and shown, never applied.
Help.Safety2: Live execution runs real code with your privileges after an explicit confirmation. Nothing is sandboxed there, exactly like a script macro.
Help.Safety3: Lesson text, hints and imported progress are data and are never executed. Only code you deliberately run is executed.
Help.Stuck1: Read the error message word by word, then use the Debugging workbench's explainer.
Help.Stuck2: Reveal a hint. The first hints are conceptual nudges, not answers.
Help.Stuck3: Open the Glossary for any unfamiliar term, or jump back to the lesson it links to.
Help.Stuck4: Compare your code with the starter code in the Workshop's Compare tab to see what you changed.
Help.KeyOpen: toggle the academy window (configurable in Controls)

Workshop.ScratchHint: Free experimentation. Nothing here is graded.
Workshop.SandboxHint: Plain JavaScript in a Web Worker. No Foundry access, no page access, time-limited.
Workshop.PreviewHint: Dry run against an emulated Foundry built from a read-only snapshot. Changes are recorded, not applied.
Workshop.LiveHint: Run against the real game with your privileges, after confirmation.

Workshop.CreateMacro: Create or update a Macro document
Workshop.RecoverPrompt: Unsaved edits were recovered from this browser
Workshop.ScriptedInputsHint: A JSON array. Each dialog in preview takes the next value: confirm → true/false, input → an object or a single value, wait → a button action id.
Workshop.NoExerciseHints: Hints belong to exercises. Open an exercise from a lesson to see its hints.
Workshop.UnsavedWarning: Your current code has unsaved changes. Continue and lose them?
Workshop.ResetWarning: Your current code in the editor will be replaced by the starter code. Saved drafts are not affected.
Workshop.DeleteDraftWarning: Delete the draft "{name}" and its version history?

OpenMenu.Name: Open the Academy
OpenMenu.Label: Open Academy
OpenMenu.Hint: Opens the learning dashboard. Also available from the token controls, the Settings sidebar, Alt+Shift+A, or /academy in chat.

Access.Name: Who can use the academy
Access.Hint: Gamemasters always can. Allow all users to let players learn too; players never gain campaign data or privileges beyond their role.

PlayerLive.Name: Allow players to run code live
PlayerLive.Hint: When enabled, non-GM users with the 'Use Script Macros' permission may run workshop code against the live game (with their own permissions and the usual confirmation). Sandbox and preview are always available.

ShowSystem.Name: Show game-system lessons
ShowSystem.Hint: Show lessons that require a specific game system (D&D 5e). They are marked unavailable when the system is not active.

DefaultMode.Name: Default learning mode
DefaultMode.Hint: How lessons present themselves to you.

FontSize.Name: Editor text size
FontSize.Hint: Font size in pixels for the workshop editor (10–24).

RequireAssessment.Name: Require the checkpoint to complete a lesson
RequireAssessment.Hint: When off, a lesson completes when its required exercises pass even if the knowledge checkpoint has not been passed.

RecordAssisted.Name: Record solution-assisted completions separately
RecordAssisted.Hint: When on, passing an exercise after revealing its full solution is recorded as 'completed with guidance'. When off, every pass counts as independent.

Notifications.Name: Show achievement notifications
Notifications.Hint: Pop a notification when an achievement is earned.

OpenBehavior.Name: When opening the academy
OpenBehavior.Hint: Open on the dashboard or jump straight back into the last lesson.

ExportProjects.Name: Include project metadata in exports
ExportProjects.Hint: Progress exports include your saved project names, descriptions and notes.

LiveWarning.Name: Live execution warning
LiveWarning.Hint: Show the full warning before every live run, or once per session (the run button still requires a deliberate click).

Open.Name: Toggle the Macro Academy
Open.Hint: Opens or closes the academy window.
